PEWTER_CITY: Even the museum has rocks. BROCK must feel very supported.
That bench has survived more trainers than I have.
CERULEAN_CITY: Five battles on one bridge. A toll booth would be less personal.
A water GYM. My shoes did not prepare for this.
VERMILION_CITY: Everyone here knows a sailor. I know a knot. It is in my shoe.
I packed for a cruise. My bag contains one sandwich.
LAVENDER_TOWN: We can sit for a minute. Nobody needs us to be funny here.
Someone still tends those flowers. I am glad they do.
CELADON_CITY: My allowance has requested that we avoid the department store.
So many roofs. Somewhere a PIDGEY is charging rent.
FUCHSIA_CITY: The SAFARI ZONE has a timer. Finally, a rule my lunch respects.
I waved at a rare POKéMON. It has chosen to remain rare.
SAFFRON_CITY: I took three turns and ended up behind myself. Excellent planning.
SILPH makes useful inventions. I would like a bag with cupholders.
CINNABAR_ISLAND: An island, a lab, and a volcano. Someone approved this arrangement.
The sea breeze is nice. The volcano breeze is less nice.
INDIGO_PLATEAU: I had a speech ready. It has become mostly breathing.
Before we go in, eat something. Heroism is hungry work.
VIRIDIAN_FOREST: Every rustle sounds enormous. Then a tiny bug walks out, offended.
The trees made a ceiling. Very thoughtful. Slightly damp.
MT_MOON: A mountain named after the moon. The moon has declined to comment.
If a fossil bites us, I am requesting a refund.
ROCK_TUNNEL: A new shade of dark. It is called more dark.
That rock looks familiar. Please tell me it is its cousin.
POKEMON_TOWER: I will keep my voice down. You can take your time.
It is good that someone remembers them. Even when it is hard.
ROCKET_HIDEOUT: They put arrows on the floor. Crime has good signage.
A base under a game corner. I assumed it was more game corner.
SILPH_CO: An office building in danger, and the elevator still works.
That employee kept their lunch. A sensible priority.
SAFARI_ZONE: The POKéMON have no schedule. We are the exhibit with a timer.
The grass is moving. I am trying to look approachable.
POKEMON_MANSION: Dusty furniture. At last, my housekeeping equals theirs.
A diary is lying open. I hope it is not about us.
SEAFOAM_ISLANDS: Ice, water, and boulders. My least convenient stairs.
If I slip, please call it a dramatic entrance.
VICTORY_ROAD: The name sounds encouraging. The boulders have other opinions.
I thought victory came with a road. We supply the road.
POWER_PLANT: The lights are off. The residents are extremely on.
Do not unplug anything. It might be somebody.
ONE_ISLAND: A warm breeze and a quiet harbor. I could get used to this bench.
Another island. Another chance to forget where I put my hat.
TWO_ISLAND: That shop sells everything. I am looking for a second pocket.
Small towns make excellent gossip. Little delivery distance.
THREE_ISLAND: A forest at the edge of town. The trees have excellent timing.
We should help before we lecture. I can lecture while walking.
FOUR_ISLAND: Daycare has the right idea. Someone else handles the exercise.
Ice in a tropical cave. The weather has lost its notes.
FIVE_ISLAND: Please let this be a relaxing walk. I scheduled the relaxing.
Someone planted flowers here. A good use of a day.
SIX_ISLAND: These ruins lasted ages. My shoes are entering retirement.
If the inscription says push, I would appreciate a picture.
SEVEN_ISLAND: Seven islands. Still one pair of socks that I actually like.
Ruins are history with fresh air. I like this museum policy.

people.BROCK: He stays calm when rocks fly. I flinch when somebody drops a spoon.
people.MISTY: A pool inside a GYM. I should have brought other shoes.
people.LT_SURGE: He calls it a shock. I prefer warnings with measurements.
people.ERIKA: She made training look restful. I have been practicing that part.
people.KOGA: A ninja who announces his name. Very considerate for a ninja.
people.SABRINA: I was going to make a joke. She probably heard the first draft.
people.BLAINE: A quiz before a battle. He combined my two anxieties.
people.GIOVANNI: A GYM and a criminal empire. I cannot manage two errands.
people.PROF_OAK: He really loves his research. I hope someone reminds him to eat.
people.BLUE: He practices being ahead of us. Exhausting to stand there.
people.LORELEI: She makes ice sound like a plan. I can barely plan a sandwich.
people.BRUNO: He lifts boulders for training. I have been carrying the bag. Surely that counts.
people.AGATHA: She has known OAK for years. That explains the advanced lecturing technique.
people.LANCE: A cape AND dragons. He has committed to the job.
